summary: Western Copper and Gold Corporation filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's interim periodic report) for the month of November 2026, furnishing unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, plus CEO and CFO Form 52-109F2 certifications. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed. Reported balances include cash of C$26.6M, short-term investments of C$94.0M, exploration and evaluation assets of C$164.2M, and a nine-month net loss of C$5.9M. A routine periodic filing; no deal terms to watch.
